title: Development Tribunal decision 26-015: dwelling alterations and Class 10a carport with 500 mm frontage and side setbacks; sewer alignment (Pelican Waters, Sunshine Coast)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.

facts.text: The applicant appealed the assessment manager's refusal of a building works development permit for alterations to an existing dwelling house and a new Class 10a carport; the Council is the concurrence agency.
The proposed setback to the Deep Water Circuit frontage is 500 mm; the notice finds that it does not meet the planning-scheme acceptable outcome requiring a 6 m road-frontage setback.
The garage is 10.7 m long along the side boundary with a 500 mm side setback; the notice cites QDC Acceptable Solution A2(d)(ii) on the total length of buildings within a boundary clearance.
The notice records that the proposal generally aligns with an existing sewer line.
The assessment manager's decision notice is dated 16 Mar 2026; QDC Part MP1.2 (Design and Siting Standard) is among the listed documents.
